posts.author: turnipmiss
posts.body:
Does this exist?
I see a lot of MMO plugins around that host external servers and such, but is there a plugin that is just simply, direct connection? Host and Join LAN play?
A lot of the already existing multiplayer plugins are a little too involved for the kind of multiplayer games I'd like to create.
I do understand that RPG Maker is not the engine you should use for multiplayer games haha

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
The critical problem with your request is the multiplayer option.
The default engine cannot handle multiplayer at all, it has only the data structure for single players.
after changing that, the exact number of players does not matter directly - it is just a question of server load. If you want 4 players or 40000 players, the code itself would be the same (unless the programmer was stupid).
And for any multiplayer, you always need a main controller deciding what is where and where interactions between player happen. That controller is usually called the 'server' of the network.
And the only technical difference would be between a dedicated server (no player on that computer) or a shared machine (both server/host and a player instance running on a single computer).
So from the technical code side, there is absolute no difference between MMO and lesser multiplayer.
